text: A narrow chest X-ray model (TorchXRayVision DenseNet-121) running on a laptop CPU
Pneumothorax film: top score is “Mass” 0.80; pneumothorax sits at the 0.50 threshold
The heatmap shows where the model looked, not where the disease is
Heatmap for “Pneumothorax” lands on the trachea, not the pleural edge
ET tube tip in the right main bronchus: an urgent ICU finding
This model has no tube-position output at all
Its heatmap sits around the carina and right hilum, near the tube and lines
Scores are not diagnoses. Check the film yourself.
